lines.text: In this lavish and expansive hall, the air is perfumed with the delicate scent of flowers.
Everywhere I look, I see people draped in attire and accessories that scream opulence.
As soon as we enter, I can sense that this place is meant for royalty.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my, you're early!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: The more I look at you, the prettier you get!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Although I'm the prettiest of them all, hehe.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Thank you for the invite today.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Thanks to you, I get to come to a lovely place like this with my husband.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'd like to say hello to your husband as well. Where is he?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: My husband?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: He's busy with work, so he couldn't come with me.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: My husband's such a workaholic

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: that he's at the top of the central government.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: He's a famous politician!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Didn't you say that he was a businessman?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my, did I?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Well, he is a businessman, but he's also involved in politics. Hehe.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh my, they are just in time!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Over here!
A seemingly married couple makes their way in our direction.

lines.speaker: royalmale
lines.text: Hello, we've heard a lot about you.

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: I heard you were looking for a couple to be friends with.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'm embarrassed... I didn't know you'd heard about that already.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I'll leave you both to chat then. See you later!
The chairman walks away to join some other people.

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: In fact, my husband is also in business.

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: He's recently achieved great success.

lines.speaker: royalmale
lines.text: Huh? Did I?

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Yes, and thanks to that we recently moved.

lines.speaker: royalmale
lines.text: Ahhh right! That's right!

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Sigh, sorry about him. He's so busy that he sometimes forgets things.

lines.speaker: royalmale
lines.text: Honey, where's our kid?

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Kid? We have a kid?

lines.speaker: royalmale
lines.text: We have a daughter, don't we?

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Ah! We left her with the babysitter today.
It seems their conversation doesn't match.

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Oh my, I'm sorry! We've only talked about ourselves, haven't we?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: No, not at all. You two seem really close.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Do you enjoy any hobbies together?

lines.speaker: royalwoman
lines.text: Ah, we...
Starting with that couple,
we interact with several others.
They all have several things in common.
Firstly, all the husbands are in business and are very interested in the subject of business.
Secondly, they kept trying to align their stories throughout the conversation.
After some time...

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Oh my! Who's this?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Aren't you my neighbors from next door?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: It's nice to see you here of all places.
Rosanna lowers her voice.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: So, Mister

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: and the lady beside...

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: What game are you playing here?
How did you know...?
D interrupts me.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Wow, it's really nice to see you.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: What a coincidence. Shall we chat for a bit?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: That's just what I was hoping for.
We move to a corner where there are fewer people.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Rosanna, the boss of Hedonia.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Didn't you say you wanted to "talk"?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Would you rather converse with our bodies, huh?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: I can see what you're hiding behind you.
I catch a glimpse of the axe blade that D is hiding.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: This is a part of my body.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: There's nothing to worry about, so don't play dumb and answer my questions.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Didn't I ask the question first?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: I asked you both what game you are playing here, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Answer that first!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I can't tell you that.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Well, if that's the case, then I can't tell you anything either.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Ah...
Rosanna turns her head towards me.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Well, then. Will you tell me, Mister?
D fixes me with a cold gaze.
I can't say. Sorry.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Well, it's okay if you don't tell me.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Still, seeing you disguised as a couple makes me mad.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: This is the man that I picked.
Rosanna approaches me
but D quickly intervenes.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll ask the next question.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: How did you know this person was {AccountData.NickName}?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: His disguise is perfect.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Hah, you call that a question?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: How can I not recognize him?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: No matter what disguise he wears, he will always be him.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: I can tell at a glance.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: But you...

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: I didn't recognize you at first, but I can tell who you are now.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: D from Perilous Siege.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: The famous axe murderer, right?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'm not a murderer.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I have the authority to do what I do.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Sure, you do.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: So, now for my next question.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: This is a couples' gathering.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Where's your companion?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Ah, right...

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: This is indeed a couple's gathering.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: But what should I do?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: There's no one I consider as my husband besides my man here.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: So I found another method.
Another method?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: There she is.
As we turn our heads to where Rosanna is looking,
a woman approaches from a distance.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Hmm... Since it's come to this,

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: shouldn't I take advantage of this situation too?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: You should try matching your stories a bit better.
Before we can even affirm or deny it, the woman draws near and speaks to us.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Rosy, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: I'm very late, aren't I?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: No, you're right on time.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Kamila.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's our target...

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: It seems you have company.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: They are...?

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: They're the neighbors living next door.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: We just happened to run into each other.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Hello, I'm Kamila.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'm Diana.
And I'm her husband, Steve.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: You three had very serious expressions when you were chatting.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: May I ask what you were talking about?

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: I'm worried I'm interrupting something...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: No, you're not. We were just...

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: It's okay, you don't have to hide it.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: We were talking about my husband's illness, right?
Rosanna gestures to me.
I can only nod my head.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Oh my... I see!

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: You were in the middle of a serious conversation.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Rosy's husband isn't in a good condition right now.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: My husband also suffered from the same illness before, so I understand.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Since it was an incurable disease, the hospital had no choice but to let him go.
So, what about now...?

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Oh, he's fully cured.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: But he still has symptoms, so it's hard for him to go outside.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I didn't know you were in that situation.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's our first time here. I thought it was a couples' gathering.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: That's why I asked where Rose's husband was.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Yes, it is a couples' gathering.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: I used to come here with my husband a lot before.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: There are exceptions for people like Rosy and me, where our husbands aren't able to attend.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: So that's why Rosy and I decided to meet here.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: I happen to be quite familiar with that illness.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: What a coincidence!

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: Kamila, perhaps you can tell them that story.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: To be honest... Steve, Diana's husband, has started experiencing similar symptoms.

lines.speaker: rosanna_m
lines.text: He's always feeling dizzy, and due to his constant cough, he has trouble breathing.
Rosanna gestures to me again.
*Cough cough*
Urgh... I feel a little dizzy.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Oh my, Honey!
D quickly supports me.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: You seem to be having a hard time. How did you come to...?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: It's all my fault!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I pleaded with him to accompany me!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We came because he said he was feeling okay today.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I didn't know his condition would worsen like this...

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Oh dear... That's unfortunate...

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: The hospital said they don't know the cause or have any treatment for it.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: But Rosy recognized my husband's condition.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: We just happened to be discussing his symptoms.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: They seem to be getting worse day by day, so I'm very worried.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Every time he has a seizure,

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I wonder if something bad will happen, and then... *Sob*
As if we've rehearsed this story many times,
D smoothly fabricates it on the spot.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Oh my! Seizures are a sign of it reaching the terminal stage.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: You need to do something quickly.
*Grab*

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I know we've just met... but I really need a favor.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: He needs treatment... No, anything that can make him better.

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Could you please tell us how your husband recovered?

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: Please!

lines.speaker: d_w
lines.text: I'll do anything to save my husband!

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: You seem... really desperate.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: ... You said you'd do anything.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Then, tomorrow morning at 8...
Kamila hands us a piece of paper.

lines.speaker: kamila
lines.text: Please, come this way.
